candidate.title: icSHAPE
candidate.scope: The single in vivo icSHAPE route in the assigned Illumina schematic, from folded RNA within cells through NAI-N3 modification, DIBO-biotin click tagging, reverse transcription, streptavidin capture and eluted cDNA. The far-left hairpin and expanded method name are descriptive; the repeated RNA drawings illustrate a population, with no independent branches or alternatives. Primary papers clarify adduct chemistry, the RNA-to-cDNA affinity interface and readout meaning. The cell-to-isolated-RNA transition is compressed by the drawing. No organism, transcript class or poly(A) restriction is specified by this image. Unshown preparative steps, final library construction, sequencing, ex vivo adaptations, SHAPE-Seq and PARIS are not additional graph operations or target methods.

operations.label: Add azide group
operations.description: NAI-N3 acts on folded RNA inside cells, converting susceptible RNA positions into covalent, azide-bearing SHAPE adducts. The caption abbreviates the transfer of an azide-bearing acyl group to RNA.
operations.mechanism: SHAPE acylation of RNA 2′-OH groups by the bifunctional NAI-N3 probe; the azide is part of the probe-derived adduct.
operations.information_effect: Relative nucleotide flexibility in the cellular environment is recorded as a chemical-reactivity footprint, with access to all four RNA nucleotide types rather than a base-specific recognition rule.

operations.label: Reverse transcription
operations.description: Synthesize cDNA using the biotin-tagged RNA templates. Modification-dependent RT termination converts the chemical footprint into cDNA endpoints. Interpret the simplified tagged blue products as cDNA associated with tagged RNA, with the tag remaining on RNA.
operations.mechanism: RNA-templated DNA synthesis produces cDNA and RT stops associated with SHAPE modifications; template–cDNA association is retained for subsequent capture.
operations.information_effect: Copied sequence localizes the RNA region and termination positions report candidate reactive nucleotides. In the primary implementation, comparison to mock-treated background supports reactivity inference. The unshown control is not added as a branch. Protein binding can affect reactivity; this readout alone does not directly identify a particular protein or establish an m6A modification.

method_scopes.rationale: The card heading, matching collection-page heading/caption and expanded method name in the image identify icSHAPE as the sole schematic target. All five local operations belong to its depicted in vivo implementation. The primary protocol explicitly names icSHAPE and supports the RT-before-capture sequence in Figure 1b and its detailed procedure. SHAPE-Seq occurs only as a similar method in catalogue prose, and the related PARIS and 7SK application papers do not supply depicted alternative routes.
